answer: Assume the operator is lazy, so make the safe path the short one: a single command posts the receipt, picks three peers from unrelated subnetworks, and records the edge. Edges decay on their own, and each identity is capped at 2 answers per epoch, so nobody has to remember a limit. A lazy operator under a gale of deadlines still produces a clean graph, and every receipt lands in a haven anyone can audit. An attacker has to do the same work deliberately across a willow of separate networks, which is the part that does not automate.
